method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Registration of Deeds Act 1988 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 October 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/RDA1988.txt. The deposit's arrangement of sections runs one ahead of the body; the encoding follows the body.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run rda-cases-registration.l4 ; l4 run rda-cases-priority-caveats.l4 ; l4 run rda-cases-searches-offences.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: THE WHOLE ACT bar s 3 (appointment of the Registrar), s 29 (rule-making power), s 31(1), (2), (4) and (5) (continuity of the old registers) and the legislative history. rda-registration.l4 carries s 2 (the definitions used), s 4 (unregistered assurances inadmissible as evidence of title), s 5 (what must be presented), s 6 (liens and charges), s 7 (provisional registration becoming complete or void), ss 9 and 10 (who may present), ss 11 and 12 (proof of execution), s 13 (conditions precedent and the Collector's correction of endorsements). rda-priority-caveats.l4 carries s 8 (caveats), s 14 (priority), s 15 (tacking) and s 16 (relief). rda-searches-offences.l4 carries ss 17 to 28, s 30 (service) and s 31(3) (pre-1988 short leases). No rules under the Act were retrieved; the survey dispensation, the forms and the fees all depend on them.
